SETUP: the MIXED big-bead sandwich. Make it beforehand on a CLEAN slide and coverslip (the old 155.8 slide has ~1,000 specks and fibres, the 98.1 one dried debris; only clean, sparse areas are used): sprinkle the 155.8, 98.1 and 76.39 um beads sparsely, aiming for ~20-30 of EACH spread over the 20 x 11.5 mm field, none touching (at least a bead's width apart), not in streaks. Nothing smaller: the small beads are what crowded the 2026-10-15 mixed slide. Coverslip on, edges taped. The coverslip rests on the 155.8 beads, so the 98.1 and 76.39 ones are NOT clamped: once mounted, watch the live view for ~10 s and only start when nothing moves. Mount it coverslip towards the camera, square to the camera at the spray plane. Any size will do for focus (their centres are within 0.04 mm in depth). Find best focus on its beads with the micrometer, by eye: that reading is z0 (write it down). Exact focus does not matter: the analysis finds best focus from the blur. Then turn back a little past z0 - 8.00 mm (e.g. -8.5, or as far as the stage goes) and forward to z0 - 8.00 mm, so the backlash is taken up. From here on always turn the SAME way (forward, towards +8). Do not slide the sandwich sideways during this slide's rows: each bead is followed at the same place through every depth.

SETUP: the 1.2 mm insert check, straight after the beads (docs/ORIFICE_CD_TEST.md; about 10 min plus the inspection). Why: on 2026-10-15 it read Cd 0.527 at every step, ~35% less gas than a clean 1.2 mm bore (as if ~0.96 mm), while the 0.5 and 0.8 mm inserts read 0.84 and 0.81 through the same line. FIRST take the insert out: look through the bore against the light for silicone residue and measure the bore (pin gauge or microscope); tell Claude what you find. Clean it if there is residue, dry it, refit it. Nozzle card: Orifice 1.2, Orifice length box = its bore length. No silicone (the line is still empty from the beads): Speed 0, RPM empty. Purge the nozzle dry (6,000 sccm for 30 s). START, then step the gas with Set Flow: 2,000 -> 4,000 -> 6,000 -> 8,000 -> 10,000 -> 12,000 sccm, about 20 s each. STOP EVERYTHING to end. The camera is not needed. Check: a clean bore reads about 1.29 barA at 12,000 sccm; on 2026-10-15 it read 1.64.
